title: Marked finite-field curve model in the source closure conventions
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k_0$, and $X/k_0$ an affine finite-type scheme. Write $\bar X=X\times_{k_0}\overline{k_0}$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $v:D\hookrightarrow\bar X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], with $D$ affine, connected and smooth of relative dimension one over $\overline{k_0}$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $x,y$ be finite points of $X$ and $s_x,s_y:\operatorname{Spec}\overline{k_0}\to D$ whose composites with $v$ are their canonical geometric lifts [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. There exist a finite extension $k_1/k_0$ with $\ell$ invertible in $k_1$, an integer $r>0$ with $|k_1|=|k_0|^r$, and an affine, separated, smooth, geometrically connected finite-type curve $C/k_1$. There are $c:C\to X$ compatible with the structure morphisms, a field isomorphism $\tau:\overline{k_0}\simeq\overline{k_1}$ compatible with $k_0$, an isomorphism $z:D\simeq\bar C$, and $u:\bar C\to\bar X$ with $u\circ z=v$. The two projection squares for $u$ commute with $c$ and $\operatorname{Spec}\tau$, and $u\circ\operatorname{Fr}_C=\operatorname{Fr}_X^r\circ u$. There are finite points $s,t$ of $C$ with $c(s)=x$ and $c(t)=y$. No Weil sheaf or local representation is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Smoothness and connectedness give irreducibility via regular local rings. Relative dimension one gives pure dimension one. Apply the existing finite-field model theorem to this prescribed curve and immersion.

proof.text: Use the model subfield and its specified embedding in kbar0. Its cardinality is the r-th power of the base cardinality. Identify its chosen closure with kbar0, construct u from its two projections, and compare the Frobenius powers by the finite-field cardinality relation. The closed images supplied universally by the model theorem give both marked finite points. This is implemented in Lean from the existing model theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_marked_geometric_curve_model
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k₀))] [IsAffine X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀))]
    (x y : X.finitePoints) (D : Scheme.{u})
    (v : D ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    [IsClosedImmersion v] [IsAffine D]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      (v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure)]
    [ConnectedSpace D]
    (sx sy : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure k₀)) ⟶ D)
    (hsx : sx ≫ v = (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberPointOfFinitePoint x)
    (hsy : sy ≫ v = (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberPointOfFinitePoint y) :
    Nonempty (MarkedGeometricCurveModel l x y D v)
